reviews.text:
When my partner and I first heard about Canine Perspective, we had already gone through one failed training experience. We were hopeful, but also skeptical. Looking back now, choosing Canine Perspective was truly one of the best decisions we have ever made for Mylo.

The change we have seen in him is incredible. Mylo is a happier, more confident dog, and because of everything we have learned through his training, we are able to do so much more with him and enjoy experiences together that we never thought would be possible. We understand him better, know how to communicate with him, and feel so much more confident handling situations that used to feel overwhelming.

One of the biggest moments for us was recently taking Mylo to the vet. Before training, his vet visits had been extremely difficult and stressful for everyone involved, so going back was something we were very nervous about. This time, he did AMAZING. Seeing him handle a situation that had been so difficult for him in the past was such an emotional and rewarding moment for us. It really showed us just how far he has come and how much this training has changed his life.

Most importantly, Mylo gets to experience more of life with us instead of being limited by his fears and reactivity. He is happier, and we are happier and more confident dog parents because of it. We are so incredibly proud of him.

There truly are no words to express how grateful we are to Jesse and the entire Canine Perspective team. They didn’t just help train our dog—they taught us how to understand him, communicate with him, and give him a fuller and happier life. They have completely changed our lives with Mylo for the better, and we will forever be grateful for everything they have done for our little family. ❤️

I am the proud owner of a mommy addicted pit bull. Won't leave my side, that is until Jesse shows up to take him to boarding. He leaves with Jesse and doesn't look back. Does that bother me? A little but I realize he must really love being with Jesse and Elizabeth. He is a people loving dog but not so much a dog loving dog.  Leaving him with Canine Perspective gives me such peace of mind. I know he will not get into trouble with other dogs. He is not excluded. He is given tread mill time with the other dogs while being in a controlled situation. He is well taken care of when he boards with Canine Perspective.  My favorite thing to say is when he is boarding I can go away and not think about him - in other words no worrying.  Yes, I still think of him but all good thoughts.  Thank you, Canine Perspective Team for a job always well done.

Way better than your average daycare! My large working breed dog always comes home well behaved, tired, obedient, ready for cuddles. In comparison to other daycares where he comes home out of control and still completely full of energy.

We cannot say enough good things about Jesse and the entire Canine Perspective team. Both of our girls completed a week-long board and train program followed by six weeks of continued training, and the experience completely changed the way we understand and support our dogs.

One of our dogs, Zuzu, struggles with territorial behavior over food and toys, intense leash reactivity, and aggression toward children and people/ dogs in general. We had tried everything to address her issues to no avail until we started working w/ Canine Perspective.

I was especially nervous going into training because Zuzu is a French Bulldog with a history of IVDD, and her back legs do not function fully because of her condition. Jesse was incredibly thoughtful, patient, and knowledgeable throughout the entire process. He communicated consistently during the board and train, never pushed Zuzu beyond her physical limits, and thoughtfully adjusted parts of the training to accommodate her mobility challenges.

Over the course of the six-week program, we gained clarity, confidence, and practical tools that we had never had before. For the first time, we truly feel equipped to set Zuzu up for success and better understand her needs and behaviors. The training combined with ecollar is the ONLY way we’ve seen real results with Zuzu’s behavior and she has transformed before our eyes.

Jesse genuinely cares about both the dogs and their owners, and it shows in every aspect of his work. We are beyond grateful for everything he and his team have done for our family, and we could not recommend Canine Perspective enough!!

We service a lot of facilities across Chicago, and this is hands down the most impressive dog daycare and training center we’ve worked in. The kennel is unbelievably clean, calm, and quiet, and you can immediately tell the dogs are structured, fulfilled, and exceptionally well cared for. Seeing dogs confidently working on the treadmills and engaging with trainers instead of nonstop barking chaos is honestly amazing. Truly a professional operation run by people who deeply understand canine behavior and dog training.

I’ve been looking for the best dog daycare in Chicago for a while, and I’m so glad I found this place. As someone who lives in the West Loop, it’s incredibly convenient, but more importantly, their approach to canine behavior is top-notch.

Unlike other facilities, they actually focus on structured play and teaching boundaries, which has made a huge difference in my dog’s temperament at home. You can tell the staff are truly professional dog trainers who understand animal psychology, not just supervised play. If you're looking for reliable dog training and daycare in Chicago, I highly recommend them. It’s been a game-changer for our family!

I’ve been with Canine Perspective for a couple of years now as a daycare, boarding and training client. My dog, Tiger, LOVES coming here and I love knowing my dog will be well taken care of while he’s there. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable and the vibe at the facility is super chill. I’m always amazed at how quiet it is there - the dogs are just playing peacefully and having fun (no loud barking!).

We just completed their 6-week in-person training with Jesse and it was a great experience. I learned so much and feel confident that I have the skills to keep progressing. And they practice the training skills while Tiger is there which helps reinforce everything we’ve learned. Here’s a pic of Tiger practicing duration and nailing it 😁🧡

** I wanted to add this -- One thing I really appreciate about their daycare approach is the structure. Instead of nonstop play, they rotate dogs through playtime, rest, and even treadmill walking -- and for Tiger, it’s been a huge benefit. He comes home calm, balanced, and tired in the best way, not overstimulated.

It’s clear they really understand dog behavior and what dogs actually need throughout the day. xoxo

We have been using Canine Perspective for Daycare & Boarding since Rummy was a puppy. Jesse & Elizabeth are so nice and care so much for all of the dogs. Rummy loves going and he comes home exhausted every time he goes. We wouldn't send Rummy anywhere else for Daycare or Boarding.

We can’t recommend Canine Perspective enough - Jesse and his team are professional dog handlers. They keep the pack safe while working with each dog’s unique personality. We have a reactive Pitbull who started at CP unable to see another dog without fear taking over. Since going through their program she has become much more confident around new dogs and much happier as a result. She is always excited to go there and we believe it’s because it’s a structured and safe environment where she can socialize, learn, AND it’s so quiet she can actually settle enough to be able to sleep.

Thank you CP!
Great place for daycare for my dog! It is a calm and well managed - friendly staff and they have been flexible when my plans have changed. I recommend them!

I have been a customer of Canine Perspective since 2022.  My rescue dog, Cass, is reactive towards other dogs and requires structure and exercise.  Jessie and the Canine Perspective team provide Cass with both in abundance.  Before trying Canine Perspective, I did not think Cass could play with other dogs due to his reactivity. However, seeing Cass play with other dogs or exercising on treadmills next to other dogs on the CP socials is a highlight of my day(Jessie & team work wonders!).  In addition, I know that they care deeply for all of the dogs entrusted to their care on any given day.  We have used Canine Perspective for daycare (Cass loves it and is always so excited to be dropped off), as well as boarding.  We trust them implicitly to keep our pup safe, and it gives us peace of mind to know that he is cared for and enriched whether he is at Canine Perspective for, be it for Daycare or Boarding.  Thank you so much Jessie, Elizabeth, and the CP Team!

Our dog trained with Canine Perspective and we use them regularly for both boarding and daycare. The training has been really helpful - both training us to be comfortable with our dog's e-collar and training our dog's previously-unruly behaviors. The fact that for dinner he now goes and sits on his bed without even being commanded is amazing.
The pickups for daycare are super helpful and we really appreciate that he has structured activities and the same rules at daycare/boarding that he does at home.
Thanks!
Thank you for always taking such great care of Lenny! Having a reactive dog can be hard, but knowing he is at a structured daycare that works with him and his needs eases my anxiety when traveling!

Canine perspective is the only place we trust with our dog. We have a reactive dog who has hated other daycares and boarding locations, but when the CP van rolls up outside our house, Arlo rushes as fast as he can out the door and into their care. So grateful to have found this community. It gives me a break once a week and makes it so we can go on family trips while knowing our dog is in good hands.
Please do not bring your dog here

We have a really sweet and social dog who is so sweet that he gets dominated and picked on by other dogs. We love how Canine Perspective provides structure to keep all the dogs safe as well as stimulated. Rufus loves Canine Perspective!
The treadmill activity is so odd. They are dogs, not humans. Go outside and touch some grass.

This review is long overdue! Jesse and his team at Canine Perspective saved my dog Benji’s life! I adopted Benji out of a home where he was biting daily. Removing him from the environment was a good start and he trusted me but didn’t trust others, and even had a level 4 bite a few months into my ownership, around May of this year. I was distraught—wondering what could possibly save Benji by correcting his biting if my love and general obedience couldn’t? That is when I found Jesse. His reviews were great online but I was still nervous, wondering if he could really help my specific case, which seemed to be such random bites from past triggers I didn’t even know.

Jesse and his team SAVED Benji! His one on one training sessions helped me understand what Benji needed—leadership, not exclusively companionship—and turned him into a calmer, more confident pup. As for the biting, we have had a couple of instances since but none even making skin contact and all able to correct to teach Benji right from wrong. Now in December, Benji can join me out to eat at restaurants, walk confidently through the airport, and play/walk freely off leash on the beach.

My biggest concern at the end of training was quality of life. Would Benji ever be able to go to a park? Have my sister pet him? And for me, would I be able to have friends over? Have a place to leave Benji while I traveled? Jesse and Canine Perspective solved all of this for me and more! Benji now attends their boarding and daycare and he loves it while I get to rest easy knowing he is getting structured playtime, keeping up on his training, and getting the specialized attention he needs. I am forever thankful for Jesse, Elizabeth, and the rest of the Canine Perspective team for all that they did for my family!

Great experience here! My dog had begun to be randomly reactive towards certain dogs and his loose leash walking also was not where I wanted it to be after so much training at other facilities.

He attended the board and train and came back a different dog! He is much more relaxed and his walking is night and day. He is much less reactive and relaxed on walks which makes our walks overall so much more pleasant.

I also appreciate the structure of their daycare. When I dropped him off, I could hear so much barking from a completely different facility down the street. Meanwhile, it was very quiet and calm inside canine perspectives which i think is great so he doesn’t pick up bad behaviors from daycare.

Overall, great training, people, and facility!

If you have a reactive dog in Chicago, look no further. Do not waste your time or money going anywhere else! I can’t thank Jesse enough for his help training my dog Bentley. I hit a complete brick wall with my reactive Border Collie, and after trying so many other options across Chicago, nothing made a real difference—until I found Canine Perspective. My dog would get extremely reactive whenever he would see a bulldog that lived in our building and ones on the street, it got to a point where I wasn’t able to control him and it would give me anxiety when I walked him but then thank God I found Canine Perspective. We did the 6 session training with Jesse and didn’t even end up needing the last session because we saw so much progress. We couldn’t believe the progress even after the first session it was hands down the best money ever spent on training.

Jesse and Elizabeth are true professionals. Their approach is incredibly customized and genuinely personable—they take the time to understand each dog’s individual personality and needs. I was especially impressed with how thoughtfully they match dogs for play sessions. It’s not random play; it’s intentional, safe, and tailored.
Before coming here, I tried “standard” daycares that felt overcrowded and overstimulating for my dog—too much chaotic play and not enough structure. Canine Perspective is the complete opposite. Their daycare is designed with the dog’s mind in mind: structured duration work, mental engagement, treadmill sessions that help dogs decompress, frequent structured walks, and small, well-balanced playgroups. Every part of the day has purpose and intention.

On top of everything, they come in at a better price point than many competitors and offer far more value through individualized care, thoughtful routines, and an environment that actually helps dogs thrive rather than become overwhelmed.

I recommend Canine Perspective for anyone searching for meaningful training and anyone who has a reactive dog—they truly changed everything for us.

We rescued our dog six years ago, and while she has always been the sweetest companion at home, her reactivity made everyday life incredibly hard. We spent years trying everything you can imagine — private trainers, group classes, small workshops, different training styles — and none of it ever really helped. We poured so much time, money, and emotional energy into trying to make things better for her, but we were still stuck. It was heartbreaking.

When we found out we’d be moving to the EU, we honestly didn’t know how we were going to make it work. The idea of flying with her, or even just navigating a new environment full of dogs, felt completely impossible. We had seen so many positive reviews for Canine Perspectives, but we didn’t really understand e-collar training and were nervous about it.

Then we talked to Jesse.

Within minutes, we felt completely at ease. He explained everything so clearly — how the e-collar works, why he uses it, what the process would look like — and we realized we were in the hands of someone who truly knew what he was doing. More importantly, someone who genuinely cared.

And the change that followed… I don’t think we’ll ever fully be able to express how much it meant to us.

In just two weeks, Jesse accomplished what years of training never even came close to. Our dog was suddenly able to walk near other dogs without melting down. We weren’t tense and on edge every time we left the house. We could actually enjoy taking her out. The relief we felt is something we still get emotional about.

It wasn’t just her behavior that changed — our entire lives changed with it. We got our freedom back. We weren’t trapped inside or constantly overwhelmed by guilt and stress. And for the first time, we felt like we could truly give her the life she deserved.

Her progress was so incredible that we were able to fly with her internationally, something we would’ve laughed at if you told us a year ago. Now we’re living in the EU, surrounded by off-leash dogs and super dog-friendly spaces, and she’s able to be part of it all. She comes with us everywhere. She’s confident. She’s happy. And we’re no longer terrified of what every outing will look like.

It feels like we have a completely different dog — or maybe like we finally get to see the version of her we always hoped was possible.

None of this would have happened without Jesse. He didn’t just help our dog; he gave us our lives back. We are endlessly grateful, and we truly cannot recommend him and Canine Perspectives enough.

While Jesse helped us make progress on our pup’s behavioral issues and overprotectiveness, what I think we appreciate most is how much better we can communicate with our gal. We understand *how* she thinks. Jesse is incredibly knowledgeable and takes the time to break down how each word and action is interpreted by our dog. Now, our communication with our pup is clearer, she’s happier and less frustrated, we can read situations and anticipate actions. She can have more freedom and independence. Our bond and our trust is stronger in each other.

Struggles with resource guarding and even darting after squirrels is less and less as we continue to use the tools Jesse has shared. And we have the skills to apply to many situations which is empowering.  We are so happy to have found the crew at Canine Perspective. They are all warm, attentive, and most importantly, great at what they do! Jesse was great with answering tons of specific questions in sessions and over email. He had solutions to all the behavioral roadblocks wed hit after other training programs.

It’s been so rewarding and such a relief. So many folks think that your dog will never be an off-leash dog, or that you just have to live with reactivity, avoiding certain situations. Jesse proves that, if you put in the work and understand your dog, that does not have to be the case. Thank you! What a gift to have his talent and this uniquely-structured daycare in Chicago.  Can't wait to get her on one of your treadmills!

Jesse was such a huge help with our dog who had some issues with reactivity, anxiety, and bathroom training from previous owners and the shelter — we honestly say "I can't believe how much better she's doing" at least once a week. She's so happy and relaxed now!

HIGHLY recommend Jesse and canine perspective! We first used Jesse and his team for our puppy Finn when he was just ~2 months old for a puppy board and train. Jesse and his team made potty training/crate training a new puppy so much easier and more realistic. We again used Jesse for a “puppy head start” program to continue to build on Finn’s foundational training. After his board and train + puppy head start, Finn was a well trained, well behaved and overall a dream dog for first time dog owners. More recently we came back to canine perspective for the third time to work on “big boy” training and began e-collar training. After a 6 week program, Finn, who is only 2 years old, is off leash trained and has impressive obedience skills. We are incredibly grateful for Jesse’s wisdom. The e-collar has been one of the most invaluable tools we have used in Finn’s training. If you want a well behaved, reliable dog we recommend Jessie as your trainer!

If you’re on the fence about training here - I couldn’t recommend this team enough. When I moved from Dallas to Chicago, something snapped in my dog and his occasional barking at dogs and people turned into full blown reactivity.  I was walking this dog at 6am and 10pm in Chicago every day praying that we didn’t see another dog. His reactivity had hit an all time high seemingly overnight and I didn’t recognize him. I was introduced to Jesse at a Solid K9 seminar that was hosted at Jesse’s facility and put him in the Canine Perspectives board and train shortly after. This is him over the past two weeks at Lincoln Park, Gold Coast, and Old Town (all very very dog heavy neighborhoods) in very busy times. We’ve had four separate occasions where little dogs have barked and lunged at him and he was fine. I have my confidence with him back so the world became a much less stressful place. We have a lot work left to do, but I couldn’t be happier because I feel like I have my dog back.

I am so grateful for Jesse, his training, and his staff at Canine Perspective! My dog struggled with reactivity, aggression, and anxiety and Jesse gave us tools to help her. We trusted them fully with her boarding when we had to leave town, and they did a great job.

Sending our dogs to Jesse and his team at Canine Perspectives was the best decision we’ve made for them. We found Canine Perspectives while searching for structured training for our 1-year-old Rottweiler, who had started resource guarding and becoming aggressive towards our older golden retriever. She was also a nightmare to walk and constantly pulled on the leash.

Jesse worked with her through a 4-week board and train program, and she came back with newfound confidence, skills, and self-control. Our Golden joined her for the last 2 weeks for his own board and train. While he had been trained by another service in the past, Jesse’s approach and results exceeded all of our expectations.

The videos Jesse sent explaining the commands have been pivotal in helping us reinforce their training. We also received follow-up sessions as part of the program, which have been incredibly helpful for addressing any post-training questions or challenges.

Before training, I never would have attempted to walk both dogs together, but now we take them out as a pair with complete control. We recently sent them back for boarding, where they not only refreshed their skills but also enjoyed a stimulating environment with trainers they know and trust.

Thank you to everyone at Canine Perspectives for caring for our pups and helping us build a stronger bond with them!

My experience with CaninePerspectives was off the charts. First, the customer service was excellent. Very attentive and kind. Because I was doing a daycare and train package they were able to help with picking up my dog. Communication was excellent and everything done was very professional. The team loves their dogs. They teach obedience in a safe way and always with kindness. The videos that Jesse provides are very detailed with all of the little details you need. For new trainees, it’s super important to watch all of the videos and practice! Follow his instructions, it works! My dog’s obedience level has increased rapidly. We are now working toward making it permanent. Which is my job. I HIGHLY recommend this family owned small business. Thank you Jesse and family!

We recently enrolled our dog in the two week Board & Train program with Canine Perspective and couldn’t be happier with the experience and results. Jesse has an incredible way with dogs and we are so impressed with how much more calm, attentive, and disciplined our 4 year old dog has been since leaving. Jesse leaves you with an interactive video and recording of your dog’s training that makes it super easy to implement at home. We’ve seen significant improvements in our dog’s obedience, social skills, and anxiety. Choosing to take our dog here was one of the best decisions we’ve ever made and an added bonus is that they always show your dog on the Instagram page! Thanks again Jesse!

My boy Enzo was difficult to train using my old ways with previous dogs. He immediately responded to Jesse's methods, the light turned on for him and two years later I have a dog who listens to me because Jesse helped us communicate. People on the street have remarked what a well trained dog I have. And for daycare and boarding, the staff at Canine Perspective is so friendly, helpful, and in tune to what dogs really need.

My 2.5 year old Labrador Murphy has always been sweet and loves people and other dogs, however he struggled with constant overstimulation. He wasn’t able to “turn off” and relax and often didn’t know his own strength when we would go for …

The team at Canine Perspective has completely changed our lives! Not only has Jesse given our power-breed pup confidence to be around strangers and other dogs but he has given us, as dog parents, a better understanding of how she operates …

I’ve been working with Jesse and Canine Perspectives for over a year now. I adopted Winston, a now 5 year old pittie mix, 2.5 years ago. He had a rough go like many shelter dogs and was reactive to dogs and over medicated for  it. …

We trained our dog Lucy at canine perspectives with incredible results. Lucy is a very reactive 65 lb dog. She loves people, but when she’s around dogs there’s really nothing we could do. Until we got Lucy trained at canine perspective for …

Canine Perspective is the best and safest place for training, daycare and boarding. The structure they instill in a day of daycare is so impressive and healthy for all dogs that attend. They come home tired, but not stressed or anxious. I can't recommend this place and the staff enough!
Thanks Drew! Always great having Plop stay with us :)

Highly recommend Canine Perspectives, I am so thankful that we found Elizabeth, Jesse and the team to help us with training for our dog Pablo. It changed our lives and his! They are the absolute best in Chicago. …

Could not recommend less! Jesse has been nothing but rude to us since day 1 and has shamed our dog. He didn’t show up to both or our recap calls, yet still blamed me. Judged (publicly) my dog for being antisocial, when he was literally 16 weeks and had barely seen the outside world.   Again, cannot recommend less. Stay away!!!!!!!!!
